title: ABIZ 1.1 Business Record (published; protocol family abiz1)
description: Structural schema for the published ABIZ 1.1 specification, the latest normative JSON Schema. ABIZ 1.0 records use schemas/abiz-business-record-v1.schema.json ($id https://abizrecord.org/schema/abiz-business-record-v1.schema.json). This revision specifies the business_key, registration_number, nested country ({ code, name }) and optional nested region rules, snake_case member names, the REQUIRED public_key and signature members (SPEC section 4.6), and the location, contact, hours and listing members (SPEC section 4.7): email and phone, blog_url and rss_url, tax_registrations, social_profiles, categories, media, review_summaries, operational_status, and structured locations with a nested address, geo, opening_hours, service_areas and external_listings. Root opening_hours, contact_email, contact_phone and flat location address members are not allowed, and recent_posts is prohibited. $defs/retired_key reserves a nested retired-key shape; it is not a record property. The schema checks only the form of public_key and signature: a consumer MUST also verify the signature over the RFC 8785 canonical record and compare public_key with the DNS or well-known p. scripts/validate.py adds the checks JSON Schema cannot express (overlapping hours, duplicate identifiers, assigned codes, time zones, URL safety). Independent DNS and registry checks are required for full conformance.

record_version.description: Wire protocol family abiz1. Document revisions, including published ABIZ 1.1, may advance without changing this value.

country.description: The business's country: { code, name }. code is an assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase and authoritative. name is a human-readable label (English short name recommended) and is never used in place of code. Not kp (SPEC section 4.2.7). The validator checks code against data/iso3166.json.

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision of country (state, province, emirate, nation of the UK) when the producer holds one. code MUST belong to country.code. Omit when there is no subdivision on the business record.

identity_host.description: DNS h value: lowercase DNS hostname with optional path; never includes https://

domains.description: Business-controlled domain names this record claims. DNS cross-check must confirm control.

public_key.description: REQUIRED (ABIZ 1.1, SPEC section 4.6.1). The business's Ed25519 public key: standard base64 of 32 bytes, 44 characters, one trailing '='. MUST equal the p value of the DNS assertion or well-known file that points to this record.

business_key.description: country[-subdivision]-registration-number (SPEC section 4.2.1). Case-insensitive; canonical form has lowercase country and subdivision and an uppercase number. Assigned codes and the subdivision rule (section 4.2.2) are checked by the validator.

registration_number.description: Normalised registration number: ASCII letters and digits only (SPEC section 4.2.3). Case-insensitive; canonical form is uppercase.

mcp_server_url.description: Optional. No conformance requirement to operate an MCP server.

email.description: Public customer-facing email address of the business (SPEC section 4.7.2).

phone.description: Primary public customer-facing telephone number of the business (SPEC section 4.7.2).

blog_url.description: Canonical public index of the business's published articles or news (SPEC section 4.7.3). Changes to posts do not change the record.

rss_url.description: Canonical public RSS 2.0 feed (SPEC section 4.7.3). Not Atom or JSON Feed. Feed items are never copied into the record.

last_updated.description: UTC date and time of the last change to the record. Covered by the signature; producers SHOULD include it and update it on every re-signing (SPEC section 4.6.6).

services.description: Services the business offers, business-wide (SPEC section 4.7.5). url is limited to 2048 characters.

locations.description: Places of business (SPEC section 4.7.6). Each location's values are its own and are not inherited from the business level. A business with no public place of business may omit locations.

tax_registrations.description: Verified, current tax registrations that the business has expressly consented to publish (SPEC section 4.7.4). Never pending, failed, expired or withdrawn claims.

social_profiles.description: Business-wide public social media profiles (SPEC section 4.7.5).

categories.description: Business-wide categories from an identified taxonomy (SPEC section 4.7.5).

media.description: Curated public media, business-level only, at most 10 items (SPEC section 4.7.9). Not a limit on the business's own gallery. Locations have no media member.

operational_status.description: Whether the business as a whole is operating (SPEC section 4.7.8).

extensions.description: Vendor-namespaced extensions (reverse-domain keys); consumers may ignore unfamiliar extensions. Member names inside an extension are vendor-defined; snake_case is RECOMMENDED. Extensions are covered by the signature.

signature.description: REQUIRED (ABIZ 1.1, SPEC section 4.6). PureEd25519 signature, standard base64 of 64 bytes (88 characters), over the UTF-8 octets of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical serialisation of this record with the signature member removed. Verified with public_key.

https_url.description: HTTPS URL, at most 2048 characters, with no user information (SPEC section 4.7.1). The validator also rejects IP literals, non-default ports and fragments.

phone.description: Public telephone number. E.164 (for example +441174960142) is RECOMMENDED; a correctly formatted local number is allowed.

code.description: Assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase. Authoritative.

name.description: Optional human-readable name in any language. Never used in place of code.

code.description: Complete ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, uppercase, for example GB-ENG or US-VT. Its country part MUST equal address.country.code. Publish only a code you have checked.

name.description: Optional human-readable state, province or region name.

street_lines.description: One to three street lines. Omit when the street is not to be published.

address.description: Public postal address of a location (SPEC section 4.7.6.2). Omit every part that is not to be published.

geo.description: WGS 84 coordinates of the premises. Both members are required together.

closes.description: Local closing time. 24:00 is the end of the day. A time earlier than opens means the next day (overnight).

periods.description: Up to four periods in order of opens, not overlapping. An empty array means closed.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier, for example Europe/London. The validator checks it is known.

weekly.description: Regular hours, at most one entry per day. A day that is absent has unknown hours; a day with no periods is closed.

exceptions.description: Dated exceptions that replace the weekly hours for that local date. An empty periods array means closed all day.

appointment_only.description: true: visits are by appointment only. Any weekly or exception periods are the hours in which appointments are offered.

social_profiles.description: Public profile URLs keyed by network. Only the listed network keys are allowed; a later revision adds keys.

taxonomy.description: A registered taxonomy token (SPEC section 4.7.5) or an HTTPS URI that identifies the taxonomy, such as a provider's published category list.

id.description: The category identifier within that taxonomy, exactly as the taxonomy writes it.

name.description: Optional display label in any language. Not an identifier.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, uppercase.

postal_code.description: A full postal code or a published outward or prefix code (for example BS1).

center.description: A coarse centre point, such as a town centre. Never the coordinates of a private address.

service_area.description: One served area: a coded country or subdivision, a postal code, or a circle. No other shapes (SPEC section 4.7.7).

platform.description: Registered platform token, or a reverse-domain name controlled by the platform operator (SPEC section 4.7.11).

public_url.description: The listing's actual public URL, as the platform publishes it. Never built from an opaque identifier.

external_id.description: The platform's public identifier for the listing, if it has one.

observed_at.description: When the publisher last saw the listing at public_url.

claimed_by_business.description: true: the business controls this listing on the platform. Absent or false: the listing was found, not claimed. A business statement, not platform verification.

rating_scale.description: The best possible rating on this platform, for example 5.

source_url.description: Public page where the summary can be seen.

review_summary.description: One platform's aggregate rating. Never combined across platforms; never reviewer names or review text.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or ISO 3166-2 code for a subdivision authority, uppercase. EU VAT numbers use the member state's code.

scheme.description: The type of tax registration. Not a claim of tax compliance.

number.description: The number as the authority publishes it.

verified_at.description: UTC time of the most recent successful check of this exact number.

verification_source.description: Who checked it: a short token naming the authority's checking service (for example vies or hmrc_vat) or an HTTPS URL of that service.

verification_expires_at.description: When the claim must be re-checked or withdrawn. Later than verified_at.

media_item.description: One curated public image or video. An image needs alt_text unless decorative is true. A video carries only id, kind, url and content_type.

location_id.description: Stable public identifier, unique within locations, kept across edits and never reused for another place. Not an internal database key.

public.description: true: the business presents this location as a place customers or visitors can go. It is not consent to publish any detail: omitted details stay unpublished.

location.description: One place of business. Its contact, website, hours and profiles are its own and are not inherited from the business level. geo requires a published street address.

retired_key.description: ABIZ 1.1. Reserved shape of one retired Ed25519 public key. Not a business-record property: no record property refers to this definition, and unknown top-level properties such as retired_keys are rejected. DNS must not carry retired keys.

public_key.description: Retired Ed25519 public key: 32 bytes, standard base64, one trailing '='.

valid_from.description: Optional UTC instant when this key became current.

retired_at.description: UTC instant when this key stopped being current. For reason compromised, the asserted compromise time.

binding_signature.description: PureEd25519 signature by the current key, standard base64 of 64 bytes. ABIZ 1.1 does not define the signed message.
